incumbent.summary: Peter Cates (Republican) is Franklin County sheriff; the county's list of elected officials shows his term expiring Dec. 31, 2026 [2]. He is not on the November ballot [1].

race_context: The Franklin County Sheriff's Office is at 371 Main St., Brookville, the county seat [4].
Open seat: Sheriff Peter Cates's term ends Dec. 31, 2026, and he is not a candidate [2, 1].
May 5, 2026 Republican primary: Sgt. Adam Henson defeated Chris Maxie, about 68 percent to 31 percent (unofficial) [5, 6].
Independent Lucas Dakota Richardson is also on the ballot [1]. No news coverage of his candidacy was found.

candidates.summary: Republican nominee and sergeant with the Franklin County Sheriff's Office, where he has worked since 1996 [7].
background: Sergeant with the Franklin County Sheriff's Office (promoted 2017); began as a jail officer in 1996 and became a deputy in 1999 [7].

Supervises the office's evening shifts and administers the Indiana Traffic Safety Grant (Operation Pull Over); has been a law-enforcement instructor since 2004, a K-9 handler and a field training officer [7].
Earlier worked with the Vincennes University Police Department; associate degree in law enforcement from Vincennes University; Indiana Law Enforcement Academy graduate (1999) [7].
Received the office's Medal of Valor and Life Saving Award in 2022 [7].
path_to_ballot: Won the May 5, 2026 Republican primary over Chris Maxie, about 68 percent to 31 percent (unofficial) [5, 6].

items: Said his supervisory roles gave him "extensive experience in budgeting, scheduling, and officer management" [7].
